newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $22 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $22 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Sept 16.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $22 billion of three- and six-month bills on Sept 16 to pay down $5.175 billion as $27.166 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued Sept 19. The three-month bills mature December 19 and the six-month bills mature March 20, 1997.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127943S1 and for the six-month bills is 9127944C5.
